data.body:
Gerrit change 2080 MERGED as be20811c52a with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. That is the ticket's substantive delivery: the helper, the guard, and all 14 conversions are on main.

The review's single advisory finding was real and is being fixed as a follow-up, change 2086 on the same ticket. The uniqueness guard excused a launch only when the '# nested-pytest-ok: <reason>' marker sat on the line of the argv literal's OPENING BRACKET. Black splits argv one element per line, so the natural place for the reason is beside the element that names pytest, several lines down — and a marker written there was silently ignored. The guard's own stated premise is that real launches are multi-line, so its escape hatch did not work for the shape it was built for. The marker is now matched against the literal's whole line span.

Evidence: narrowing the window back to the bracket line alone makes the new test_a_marker_inside_a_black_split_launch_excuses_it FAIL (assert [3] == []). Reintroducing a genuine Black-split launch in tests/_store_isolation.py with an in-span marker now passes the guard, where before the fix it would have been reported as an offender.
